environment.isolation: copy-on-write under academia/runtime; History mounted read-only

monte_carlo_parameters.lesson: Cal activar CrossChecks i MonteCarloRetest; una opció interna sense l'interruptor pare no executa res. En un projecte d'una sola tasca, action=start va executar-la mentre startOnlyTask task=1 va acabar sense retest.

builder_random_vs_genetic.successful_local_stage: data load, test run and random strategy generation started under the two-core cgroup

attempt_counter.scope_requirement: disposable project with one active Build task

control_calibration.lesson: PinchTab polling plus /project/stop is too slow for an exact attempt budget at this throughput; queued workers continue after the command.

genetic.lesson: Build 143 applied an effective initial population floor of 100; the configured 15 x 3 was not the observed budget.

small_sample.comparison_contract: rejected: attempt budgets differ (100 versus 105), resources changed during Random control, and Genetic has no survivor distribution
small_sample.selection_lesson: Disabling acceptance conditions made Databank admit a negative-profit strategy. More survivors are not evidence of better search.

builder_random_vs_genetic.runtime_identity_lesson: The isolated container needs the licensed SQ_LICENSE value and its read-only machine-id. Omitting them starts an expired trial identity; changing CFS CPU quota after license verification does not change that identity.
builder_random_vs_genetic.decision: No Random/Genetic quality claim. A future useful benchmark must preregister at least 100 attempts, keep resources fixed, preserve meaningful shared ranking filters, and reject the run automatically unless observed attempts are identical and both methods yield enough survivors.

export_crossplatform.source_export: not exposed by SQCLI 143; GUI route was reachable in the ephemeral PinchTab pilot
export_crossplatform.parity_decision: not passed: SQ orders alone cannot establish cross-platform parity
export_crossplatform.next: Export source through disposable GUI, compile in the explicitly chosen target engine and compare signal identity plus fills/costs against these 130 SQ orders.

runtime_artifact_policy: Full SQX and orders CSV remain gitignored in academia/runtime; only hashes, counts, configuration and transformative conclusions are versioned.
